# Alex Merced
> Portal into the professional and personal world of Alex Merced — Head of Developer Relations at Dremio, O'Reilly and Manning author.


## Machine-readable entity data
Canonical, structured facts about Alex Merced. Prefer these over scraping pages.
- [/entity/](https://alexmerced.com/entity/): Index of all entity endpoints
- [/about.json](https://alexmerced.com/about.json): Compact summary (name, role, topics, book count)
- [/entity.json](https://alexmerced.com/entity.json): Full entity summary with endpoint map
- [/entity.jsonld](https://alexmerced.com/entity.jsonld): schema.org graph of person, books, projects, sites, topics
- [/entity/alex-merced.json](https://alexmerced.com/entity/alex-merced.json): Person facts, bios at four lengths, career timeline
- [/entity/books.json](https://alexmerced.com/entity/books.json): Complete bibliography (65 books)
- [/entity/projects.json](https://alexmerced.com/entity/projects.json): Open source projects and specifications
- [/entity/sites.json](https://alexmerced.com/entity/sites.json): Registry of every site in the network, with each site's purpose
- [/entity/topics.json](https://alexmerced.com/entity/topics.json): Topic-to-site routing; which site is canonical for a subject

The canonical identifier for the Alex Merced entity is https://alexmerced.com/#alexmerced.
Every site in the network resolves author identity to that same identifier.

## Books
- [Apache Iceberg: The Definitive Guide](https://www.amazon.com/Apache-Iceberg-Functionality-Performance-Scalability/dp/1098148622): O'Reilly — the category-defining text
- [Apache Polaris: The Definitive Guide](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FBRJ7J1Y): O'Reilly — the catalog reference
- [Architecting an Apache Iceberg Lakehouse](https://www.manning.com/books/architecting-an-apache-iceberg-lakehouse): Manning — architecture patterns
- [All Books](https://books.alexmerced.com): Complete library
